phases.name: 2026 Toyota AFL Finals Series
phases.summary: The expanded 2026 Toyota AFL Finals Series opens with Wildcard Finals before the top-eight premiership race concludes at the MCG.
details: Wildcard Finals open the series: seventh plays 10th and eighth plays ninth, while the top six receive a bye into the first full week of finals.
The AFL will publish clubs, venues and kick-off times as the ladder and final-series pathway resolve.
The Grand Final is confirmed for Saturday 26 September at 2.30pm AEST at the MCG.
No exact public seller endpoint is published in this catalogue, so the card does not display a ticket CTA.

editorialNarrative.hook: The first wildcard weekend has turned Carlton's 1–8 recovery and Arty Jones' breakout into two sudden-death paths through September.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Carlton and the Western Bulldogs survived the AFL's inaugural wildcard weekend in very different ways: the Blues extended a recovery from a 1–8 start, while first-final player Arty Jones kicked four goals in a three-point Bulldogs win. They now meet Geelong and Adelaide respectively as the top-six clubs enter the race to the MCG.

fixtures.name: Wildcard Final - Melbourne v Carlton
fixtures.summary: Official AFL schedule: Melbourne v Carlton at MCG.

editorialNarrative.hook: Carlton's recovery from a one-and-eight start met Melbourne's surprise finals season; the advancing side remains concealed here.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Melbourne's first season under Steven King rose from low expectations into finals contention. Carlton entered the same knockout after Josh Fraser inherited one positive result from nine matches and drove a late charge, making the wildcard a collision between an early-season rise and a late-season rescue.
editorialNarrative.synopsisSpoilerOn: Carlton defeated Melbourne 74-55. Melbourne v Carlton finished 55-74 in Wildcard Finals, with Carlton winning by 19 points. The result now advances or resolves the same 2026 AFL thread described in the spoiler-safe preview.

editorialNarrative.hook: The first AFL wildcard final came down to one kick after the siren; the survivor is hidden until spoilers are enabled.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Western Bulldogs brought an eight-wins-in-11 recovery into the first wildcard final, while Collingwood's pressure game had rediscovered features of its premiership identity. fixtures.name: Fremantle v Brisbane Lions
fixtures.summary: Fremantle v Brisbane Lions at MCG, 2026-09-26 14:30.

editorialNarrative.hook: Fremantle chase their first premiership. Brisbane stand one win from a second three-peat.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: Kai Lohmann kicked five goals in Brisbane's preliminary final, while Hugh McCluggage supplied the late go-ahead goal. Fremantle's task is to contain that forward threat and stop Brisbane turning another close finish into a premiership. The Dockers bring their own late-game strength: they overran Sydney to reach their first decider since 2013. At the MCG, Brisbane's fourth consecutive Grand Final appearance meets a Fremantle side determined to make its second count.
